title: SBA Fraud Enforcement Extension Act
committees: H-Small Business Committee: Referred To 2025-07-17 -> Markup By 2025-07-22 -> Reported By 2025-08-15
latest_action: Received in the Senate. Read twice. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 281.
summary: SBA Fraud Enforcement Extension Act This bill extends the statute of limitations to 10 years for fraud-based criminal and civil offenses with respect to the Shuttered Venue Operators Grant and the Restaurant Revitalization Fund COVID-19 relief programs.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
